lines: My dear little sheep, it seems we have a new listener—The Angel of Aijinkova!
Oh, How long has it been? Five years already? Ah, the memories!
You know, I have to thank you. Without you, I wouldn't be having this much fun!
You really think I give a rat's ass about this revolt against you? I couldn't care less.
I just wanted an excuse to prove to you that I'm better, that I've finally surpassed my own m–
